currentParagraphText: Miranda sighed and leaned forward. “Right now, they have nothing. Iludar is dead, the Holy Church has surrendered, and they have no allies left besides each other. What’s more, Iludar even tried to just leave them all behind to save his own skin. While I’m not saying they will be a big boon or anything to have on our side, I do believe there are some benefits to expanding our fighting force. Successfully integrating them will also reinforce your actions today that even if we are a faction led by the Chosen of the Malefic Viper, we can still be reasonable and merciful.”
